title: TerraFlux mobile weather response v1

forecast.description: The existing temperature and wind forecast. Its grid defines the row-major cell order for the precipitation arrays.

period_start_utc.description: Start of the accumulated precipitation interval.

valid_time_utc.description: End of the accumulated precipitation interval.

values.description: Row-major accumulated precipitation values aligned with forecast.grid; null cells must have a non-decoded quality status.

quality.description: Row-major per-cell status aligned with values and forecast.grid.

description: The precipitation arrays must each contain exactly forecast.grid.nx * forecast.grid.ny entries and use the same grid geometry, coordinate reference, and row-major y-then-x ordering as the forecast. A decoded cell has a numeric value; no_data and ambiguous cells have null values. The rainfall layer is an observation-derived accumulation and is not an input or output of the dry temperature transport solver.
